description: Import a plain Postgres database (Neon, Render, RDS, self-hosted) into an environment. POST /v1/imports. Only a connection string is needed: unlike Supabase, there is no platform API alongside the database, so no service key or storage is asked for. With dry_run true it reports what would move and changes nothing; without it the import starts in the background (so requires confirm) and returns an import_id to follow with import.status.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply this mutation; otherwise the tool returns the request it would send for approval.

dry_run.description: Report only, do not migrate (default false)

source_schemas.description: Comma-separated schema names to copy (default: every non-system schema)

name: import.postgres
